heading:
Built by artists,
for artists.
Engineered at MIT.
Made in Brooklyn.
body: For twelve years, Matr's artists and technicians have developed new ways of making art alongside some of the most influential artists working today. Now there are two ways to work with us: the Oil Edition, which carries everything we learned at a price open to every artist, and the Studio, for work that goes further.

video.alt: Overhead view of a Matr printer laying color across a richly layered print
